purpose: Freeze the sole Campaign120 return-direction dictionary phrase-count definition, parser, source, ordered no-return gates, complete finite comparison boundary, one development trial, execution assumptions and stop rules before opening Campaign120 values.

candidate.name: intraday_return_direction_dictionary_phrase_count_238s
candidate.economic_hypothesis: Higher incremental phrase novelty represents a wider completed-session repertoire of direction motifs and less dominance by stale or mechanically repeating micro-paths, potentially indicating more resilient information absorption over the next three sessions.

exact_formula.symbol_rule: Inside each half, encode each exact adjacent raw close comparison as -1, 0 or +1; all 240 closes must be finite and strictly positive and no tolerance, return magnitude or logarithm is used after the comparison.
exact_formula.dictionary_rule: For each 119-symbol half independently, reset an empty dictionary. At the current cursor take the longest dictionary-member prefix w, emit and add w plus the next symbol when one remains, or emit the already-known remaining suffix once without re-adding it when w reaches the end. Advance through every symbol exactly once.
exact_formula.support: Require exactly 240 valid closes, 238 recognized ternary symbols, exact consumption of both 119-symbol sequences and a finite integer score in [2,238]; constant paths remain valid.

comparison_contract.direction_normalization: use every comparator's frozen score direction

ordered_no_return_gates.name: binding_source_snapshot_and_implementation_verification
ordered_no_return_gates.rule: Before source values bind this protocol, pure formula implementation, tests, raw and joint-clean sources and output path. After publication verify every partition byte/frame hash, exact close-only projection/grid/parser/support/range/count and aggregate dataset digest.

ordered_no_return_gates.name: structural_coverage_variation_and_capacity_before_comparator_values
ordered_no_return_gates.rule: On the immutable quality/current-listing base require median daily coverage >=0.95, P05 daily coverage >=0.90, P05 eligible names >=50, at least 200 non-overlapping three-signal-session cohorts, at least five observed years, integer values in [2,238], and at least 200 nonconstant cross-sectional sessions. Failure stops before comparator, daily-price or forward-return values.

ordered_no_return_gates.name: all_137_numeric_uniqueness_after_coverage_only
ordered_no_return_gates.rule: Compare in exact v109 numeric order with all 137 eligible numeric comparators. Each comparison requires at least 50 paired names per session and at least 100 qualifying sessions. Every absolute median daily average-tie Spearman correlation must be strictly below 0.8; insufficient overlap fails closed and no comparator may be removed.

finite_development_catalog_if_admitted.purge: Purge three signal sessions at every train/validation boundary; t+1 entry and t+3 exit must remain in the same partition.
finite_development_catalog_if_admitted.execution: Reuse the frozen one-factor next-open to third-close Top-3 engine, CNY 200000 board-lot pilot, quality/listing gates, amount-participation checks, 0/5/10/20bp stress grid and survivor gates without override.
finite_development_catalog_if_admitted.stress_2024_2025: Open once only if the sole trial survives every 2019-2023 gate and a nonzero survivor record freezes the campaign; label historically exposed quasi-out-of-sample. Otherwise keep closed and unread.

next_action: Implement and synthetically test the exact parser and vectorized formula without opening historical source values, then fingerprint-freeze code and tests before one no-return snapshot build.
